After USDA revises an item for a marketing year, how often its next revision of that item goes the same way. Well above 50% means revisions trend: USDA moves toward the final number in steps.

Export pace

Pace-implied exports at this point of the season: mean abs error 23.93% of final vs 21.48% for USDA's same-month forecast; called the direction of USDA's next export revision 65% of the time (n=10).
